notes.title: Patch Notes Demo V.024
notes.content:
Demo Version .024

[list]
[*] Added a new puzzle after beating the boss. It’s a bit hidden and will require the special collectible to unlock.
[*] Fixed weird double jump issue
[*] Minor polish on props placement
[*] Fix couple of issues in the gym
[*] Added more icon on the map in the “legend” section
[*] Change full heart asset to be a ¼ image instead of a ½
[*] Replace the dice pushable for a crate
[*] The dice will be back later as a boss
[*] Fix issues in the bottom right puzzle of the 3rd page
[*] New art for missing icons
[/list]

It is recommended to start a new game (Erase all data in the options menu) because some collectibles ID have changed. Sorry about that!
